liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Raven Space** (2 reviews): Show is known for Phil's Raven space; Reviewer found the show ordinary until Space, where the band got a bit wacky, a welcome break [16][17]
- **They Love Each Other** (1 review): This version was played at the reviewer's wedding as their song [18]
- **Jack Straw** (1 review): Opening Jack Straw was magnificent though slightly fast [22]
- **Stella Blue** (1 review): Stella Blue was touchingly heartfelt [22]
- **Truckin'** (1 review): Reviewer thinks alternate lyrics were sung, with sex-change replacing the vitamin C and cocaine line [22]
- **Peggy-O** (1 review): Reviewer especially enjoyed this Peggy-O [24]

## Setlist highlights

- **gd82-04-19 s1t01 Tuning**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [25]
- **gd82-04-19 s1t02 Jack Straw**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [25]
- **gd82-04-19 s1t03 They Love Each Other**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [25]
- **gd82-04-19 s1t04 On The Road Again**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [25]
- **gd82-04-19 s1t05 Peggy O**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [25]
- **gd82-04-19 s1t06 Cassidy**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [25]
- **gd82-04-19 s1t07 It Must Have Been The Roses**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [25]
- **gd82-04-19 s1t08 Little Red Rooster**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [25]

## The recordings

- **gd1982-04-19.144567.sbd.healy.streeter.smith.miller.clugston.flac1648** (recommended): soundboard; 24 songs; 174 min; rated 4.25/5 by 4 [1]
- **gd1982-04-19.mtx.tobin.89389.flac24**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 22 songs; 175 min; rated 5/5 by 2 [4]
- **gd82-04-19.aud-martin.warner.19420.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 21 songs; 169 min; rated 4.71/5 by 21 [10]. Said about its sound: Audience recording is well balanced, with Phil's bass prominent behind and clear interplay between Jerry and Brent; Audience tape captures the experience's essence, with Phil standing out in the space; Audience recording is so good it could be mistaken for a soundboard [14][19][20][21]
- **gd1982-04-19.144568.sbd.healy.streeter.smith.miller.clugston.flac2496**: soundboard; 24 songs; 174 min; rated 4/5 by 3 [2]

## Around the show

- Reviewer drove from Raleigh to Baltimore with friends the day of the show, got in without tickets; it ended the tour [15]
- Reviewer came by bus from Western Maryland College and bought a shirt reading 'On the road again' showing a skull burning a joint [18]
- Reviewer finds this audience tape warmer and livelier than the flat-sounding soundboard version of the same show [16]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1982-04-19.144567.sbd.healy.streeter.smith.miller.clugston.flac1648**: taped by Dan Healy & Frank Streeter; transferred by Matt Smith, Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Dan Healy's Master Soundboard Cassettes (Sony TC-D5M/TDK MA-R90/dolby B)> Frank Streeter's 1st generation 1/4 track Reels @ 3.75 ips (Sony TC770/Maxell… [1]. Also: Steven Martin's modified Nakamichi 700 audience source patches the Jack Straw start, part of Little Red Rooster, and Weir's intro to Man Smart [1]
- **gd1982-04-19.mtx.tobin.89389.flac24**: transferred by Kevin Tobin; source: SBD (89313) + AUD(19420) Matrix 2 Source Mix (60%-SBD/40%-AUD) [4]. Also: Matrix mix aligning soundboard and audience sources, assembled and volume-adjusted in Audition 3.0, then encoded to DTS [4]
- **gd82-04-19.aud-martin.warner.19420.sbeok.shnf**: taped by Steven Martin; source: Audience Recording: Nak CM700's [10]. Also: Taped by Steven Martin with modified Nakamichi CM-700 mics into a Sony TC-D5M, then transferred to CD and shn [10]
- **gd1982-04-19.144568.sbd.healy.streeter.smith.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Dan Healy & Frank Streeter; transferred by Matt Smith, Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Dan Healy's Master Soundboard Cassettes (Sony TC-D5M/TDK MA-R90/dolby B)> Frank Streeter's 1st generation 1/4 track Reels @ 3.75 ips (Sony TC770/Maxell… [2]

## Art and photos
